about:
Anchorage Sheet Metal is a locally owned and operated custom fabrication shop in south Anchorage, Alaska. The company has served Alaska for over 26 years, though its exact founding year is not publicly stated. No founder names are disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication and HVAC services, including ventilation systems, staircase handrails, and custom artistic metalwork. Core processes include computerized plasma cutting, stainless steel fabrication, on-site welding and polishing, and stainless steel equipment repair and modification. The company also operates as a licensed mechanical contractor. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

The business serves commercial, residential, and industrial clients across Alaska needing HVAC installation, custom fabrication, and mechanical contracting. Concrete examples from the company's description include ventilation systems for buildings, staircase handrails for architectural projects, and custom metal art pieces.

Anchorage Sheet Metal emphasizes that its servicemen are licensed, bonded, and insured, and that the company holds HVAC certification. It promotes competitive pricing and unmatched service as key differentiators.
